calls.title: Lawrence and August Allard
calls.summary: The meeting discussed the urgent need to hire a senior support engineer to address a significant gap in support coverage for the Asia Pacific region, which is crucial for enhancing responsiveness and customer satisfaction. Currently, Growth Book has around 40 employees, with support engineers primarily covering Europe and America. The new hire will receive onboarding support from colleagues in Japan and the UK, and if growth continues, a fourth support engineer will be added by year-end. The team has handled over 3,000 support requests in the last year, reflecting a growing workload. Additionally, an integrated, AI-enabled support system using Pylon was reviewed for its efficiency in ticket handling and autonomous resolutions. Lawrence Liz, a candidate with extensive relevant experience, was highlighted in the candidate evaluation process, emphasizing collaboration and communication skills.
calls.keywords: Senior Support Engineer, Asia Pacific, Growth Book, A/B Testing, Pylon Ticketing, AI Support Agent
